DIT.why: Supplies laser annealing systems for DRAM/NAND wafers and AOI wafer inspection, sold mostly to SK Hynix under disclosed equipment contracts; DRAM/HBM capacity spending at SK Hynix drives its revenue (customer A 83.96% of sales).
DIT.evidence: DIT half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): five single sales/supply contracts with SK Hynix for semiconductor manufacturing equipment (KRW 15,390M to KRW 31,740M); laser annealing systems for DRAM/NAND supplied as mass-production tools.

players.product: Laser annealing systems for DRAM/NAND wafers and AOI wafer inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 90,060,435,821 (H1 2025: KRW 50,716,836,678) and operating profit KRW 30,535,506,216 (H1 2025: KRW 13,772,473,712); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 41,600,866,275 (Q2 2025: KRW 29,072,553,774) and Q2 operating profit KRW 14,097,114,502 (Q2 2025: KRW 8,496,096,764); H1 net income KRW 28,404,400,756 (H1 2025: KRW 14,608,050,388). Equipment sales KRW 81,966M (91.01%), services KRW 5,215M (5.79%)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 90,060,435,821; operating profit KRW 30,535,506,216

quarterly_data.signal: Products: laser annealing systems that raise DRAM/NAND wafer yield (void removal in high-selectivity contacts/trenches, contact silicidation anneal, VNAND dopant activation and Si recrystallization), delivered to customers as mass-production tools (first supplied July 2023); SiC power-semiconductor laser annealing for ohmic contacts (supplied from April 2024); AOI inspection of DRAM/NAND wafer surfaces (cracks, chipping, particles) with deep-learning defect classification. Registered as an SK Hynix tier-1 supplier in December 2018 and named an SK Hynix Best Partner in November 2024. H1 2026 R&D KRW 9,970M (11.07% of revenue)

Customer concentration (names withheld as trade secrets): customer A 83.96% and B 10.22% of standalone H1 2026 sales; consolidated, customer A KRW 75,617,121 thousand (0.84 of revenue; H1 2025: KRW 31,580,122 thousand, 0.62) and customer B KRW 9,205,074 thousand (0.10)

Order backlog KRW 67,651M at June 30, 2026 for AOI and laser solutions (orders KRW 157,711M, delivered KRW 90,060M), with delivery in 2026-2027; transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations KRW 64,914,427 thousand; contract liabilities KRW 7,159,160,757 vs KRW 2,299,073,224 at end-2025

Legal: the Daejeon District Prosecutors' Office indicted the company and employees on June 20, 2025 for alleged violations of the Industrial Technology Protection Act; EO Technics claims damages for trade-secret infringement and obtained provisional attachments of the company's movable assets and real estate in August 2025, and the company deposited KRW 8,000,000 thousand to lift the movable-asset attachment; no provision recognized
